_README: Import into n8n: watches Gmail for mail from Angela and POSTs to Denizen Meridian CRM /api/crm/email-inbound. Attach Gmail OAuth2 credential. Set X-Denizen-Secret if DENIZEN_EMAIL_SECRET is set on the server.
name: Denizen — Angela Gmail → CRM

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ from: $json.from, fromEmail: $json.fromEmail, subject: $json.subject, body: $json.body, bodyText: $json.bodyText, threadId: $json.threadId, id: $json.id, gmailId: $json.gmailId, snippet: $json.snippet, source: $json.source, org_slug: 'zion' }) }}
